svg.text: B200 · MSAPairWeightedAveraging · training · d_msa 64, d_pair 128, 8 heads × 32, bf16, MSA residual, row dropout
forward (saves w, v, y, o and the dropout keep-mask)
b = LN_z(z) @ W_b.T # LN folded into W_b
F4 · gate + out projection + dropout + residual
backward (dres; the residual's gradient is dres itself)
B2 · gate glue (dgp stays on chip)
g = sigmoid(y @ W_g_h.T); du = dr @ W_o_h
do = du * g; dgp = du * o * g (1 - g)
dW_o += dr^T (g o); dW_g += y^T dgp
dy_g = dgp @ W_g # the gate branch of dy
dW_v = dv^T y; dγ_m, dβ_m = 1^T [dy x̂ | dy]
db = w (dw - sum_j w dw) # softmax backward
dW_b, dγ_z, dβ_z from M = db^T x̂, sum db
